strings.subtitle: — Omusaanyizzi wa fayiro —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Okuwamba n'okuleka tewali. Kozesa bbaaputa wammanga.
strings.shred_button: S A A N Y I Z A
strings.ssd_warning:
Kulabula! Ku SSD, enkola y'okuwandiika waggulu tteekeddwa ku TRIM teykkiriza kusaanyiza.
Entegeka eno ya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fayiro "{name}" ejja kuwandiikibwa waggulu era esazibwe.

Weeyongere?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Kino kika kimu ku shortcut (.lnk). Shortcut yokka ejja kusaanyizibwa.

Fayiro gy'ekulaga ejja kusigala nga ntuufu.

Weerakako?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Kino kika kya network (\\server\share).
Okusala mu seza tekikakasa kusaanyizibwa — seza ayinza okuba n'eza snapshot, deduplication oba CoW.

Weerakako?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Kino kika kya kuggya (USB / HDD ey'ebweru).
Controller ayinza okutereka block enkadde mu reserve.

Weerakako?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS emigendo gy'amakulu emirala (ADS) tegikolebwa.
• Ekitabo kya USN tekyerongoosebwa.
• Ebifaananyi by'ekisiikirize n'enkola z'ekire
  (OneDrive n'ebirala) tebikwatibwa.
strings.status_full: Ebirimu byawandiikibwa waggulu ddala ne ziiro. Okuzzaawo tekisoboka — ebikozesebwa bijja kulaba ziiro zokka.
strings.status_fast: Omutwe, omukira n'ennyiriri 4 MB byawandiikibwa waggulu. Ebirala tebikwatiddwa, naye olw'ebifo, okuzzaawo ddala n'ebikozesebwa by'abakozesa tekisoboka. Ku biwandiiko eby'ekyama kozesa enkola EJjuve.
strings.status_empty: Fayiro yali nkalu, okuwandiika waggulu tekwetaagisa. Esaziddwa.
strings.error_permission: Tosobola kutuuka ku fayiro. Ayinza okuba ng'eguliddwa mu pulogulaamu endala. Ggalawo ogezeeko nate.
strings.error_not_found: Fayiro tesangiddwa. Ayinza okuba ng'esaziddwaamu dda.
strings.error_is_symlink: Kino kika kya symbolic link. Link tezisobola kusaanyizibwa — fayiro gy'ekulaga ejja kusigala nga ntuufu.
strings.error_reparse: Kino kika kya placeholder (OneDrive oba ekifaanana). Data yaayo eri mu cloud, si ku diski — tewali kya kusaanyiza wano.
strings.error_not_file: Kino si fayiro (folder oba ekirala). Wawula fayiro.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fayiro eno erina hard link endala ({n} zonna). Hard link tezirina nkulu — amannya gonna genkanankana. Bw'osaanyiza mu kkubo eriwo, data ejja kuwandiikibwako era etemebwe ku 32 bytes, naye ekisigadde kijja kusobola okutuukibwako mu link endala. Sangula link zonna.
strings.error_compressed:
Fayiro ekompresseddwa, esimbiddwa oba nnyingi. Okuwandiika ku zero tekikakasa kusaanyizibwa kwa data enkadde kubanga NTFS egitereka mu ngeri endala.

Ggyawo attribute: nyiga ku ddyo → Properties → Advanced → ggyawo 'Compress' ne/oba 'Encrypt'. Oluvannyuma ddamu ozise SHREDDER.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Fayiro {count} zijja kusaanyizibwa.
Obunene bwonna: {size}.

Kebera olukalala nga tonnatandika.
Ekikolwa kino tekisobola kuddizibwa.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Ggyayo fayiro zonna {count} mu lunyiriri?

Fayiro zennyini TIZIKUKWATIBWAKO — olukalala lwokka.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fayiro "{name}" erina hard link endala ({nlink} zonna).

Data ejja kusaanyizibwa ku mannya gonna.
Naye ebisigadde (32 bytes) bijja kusigala wansi w'amannya amalala mu folder.

Oyinza okwetaaga okusangula ebisigadde bino n'emikono.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Kozesa ku hard link zonna mu lunyiriri
